blocks.text: LONDON, United Kingdom — Robert Pattinson, chosen to succeed Daniel Craig as James Bond, completes his rise from brooding on-screen teen heartthrob to global superstar in the role of the world’s most famous secret agent. The 40-year-old will helm the storied 007 franchise acquired by Amazon MGM after already becoming a serious Hollywood player with his turn as Batman in 2022 and featuring in Christopher Nolan’s recent epic “The Odyssey”. After building a cult following in “The Twilight Saga”, the British actor has also received plenty of critical acclaim for his eclectic roles in various arthouse films, while Oscars buzz is […]...
